newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-DECISION ON EMEX MONOPOLY POSTPONED.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-DECISION ON EMEX MONOPOLY POSTPONED.

text.p: The government on Tuesday postponed the abolition of the monopoly status of the Estonian Metal Export company (EMEX) in the trade of scrap metal.
Economy Minister Jaak Leimann told a news conference that government wants to pass the law a licencing the trade before it abolishes the monopoly, which EMEX has had since 1993.
"We postponed a bold decision," Leimann said.
Leimann added that the government was afraid that the theft of cables and other illegal metal trading would intensify without any regulation.
The privatisation agency at the end of June picked Nelimet, a company hold by EMEX's management, to privatise 51 percent of its shares.
Five percent of EMEX's shares were sold for vouchers last year and they are actively traded on the OTC market.
